blocks.p: The sandbox settings of a saved game can be changed while you play it, from the pause window. The feature is off until you turn it on: in *ZeD setup*, under *Additions*, switch on *Sandbox options in game*. With it on, the pause window has a *Sandbox options* line under *Options*.

caption: Figure 49-1
The pause window, left, and the list of pages, right.

blocks.p: The game stays paused while the window is open. In multiplayer the line is not shown.

marks.text: With Sandbox options in game turned on in ZeD setup, the pause window has a Sandbox options line.
The Changed and History pages come last in the list.

sticky.text: Change the sandbox settings in game.

blocks.p: Each row has the setting's control and, at its right, a tag that says when a change takes effect: *Now*, *New places*, *New characters*, *Next load* or *Fixed*. A second tag marks a risk: *Careful* or *Can't undo*. *Apply* stays dim until something changes, and asks before it goes ahead.

caption: Figure 49-2
The World page and its help band.

marks.text: Each setting says when a change takes effect: now, in new places only, or fixed.
What it does, what changing it does to this save, and a tip.
Apply stays dim until something changes.

sticky.text: Off until you turn it on in ZeD setup.
